Package de.eldoria.eldoutilities.config

Class JacksonConfig<T>

java.lang.Object
dev.chojo.ocular.Configurations<T>
de.eldoria.eldoutilities.config.JacksonConfig<T>
Type Parameters:
T - type of main configuration
All Implemented Interfaces:
DebugDataProvider, dev.chojo.ocular.dataformats.Configurator<ObjectMapper,MapperBuilder<ObjectMapper,?>>
public class JacksonConfig<T> extends dev.chojo.ocular.Configurations<T> implements DebugDataProvider
Configuration files of a plugin, stored as yaml relative to Plugin.getDataFolder().

Files are managed by ocular's Configurations and identified by a Key. This class adds the server specifics: files are read with the plugin class loader, which polymorphism and the library loader rely on, the Paper module of jackson-bukkit is registered, and every loaded file is exposed as debug data.
